title.narrative: Support to the Implementation of the Maputo Accord for Peace and Reconciliation ¿ Phase 2

description.narrative: The Project ¿Support to Implementation of the Maputo Accord for Peace and Reconciliation - Phase 2¿ will continue supporting: 1) The core operations of The Secretariat, which will implement or coordinate a number of strategic functions needed to underpin the full implementation of the Maputo Accord; and 2) the disarmament and demobilisation process ensuring ex combatants receive necessary support in the transition towards their reintegration into the community.
